create_VideoCapturer: create a VideoCapturer instance for a given camera device index
start_VideoCapturer: start the VideoCapturer with custom width, height, and fps settings
read_VideoCapturer: read frames from the VideoCapturer and return the latest frame
set_frame_callback_VideoCapturer: set a frame callback on the VideoCapturer for real-time frame processing
release_VideoCapturer: release the VideoCapturer and free camera resources
